_readme: Manual support-triage baseline. 'estimate' values are placeholders until timed with `py main.py time-manual <step_id> --workflow tickets --items N`.

manual_steps.name: Read the ticket, pick category and priority
Search past tickets for a similar resolution
Write the escalation message for engineering
Engineering asks back for missing details

automated_human_steps.name: Agent checks the AI tag before accepting
Agent edits the AI draft before sending
Low-confidence tickets handled fully by hand (2+4+6 min)
Manager reviews legal / refund / chargeback tickets
Agent confirms the generated Slack brief
